preferred_strategy.name: Adaptive balanced
preferred_strategy.description: Combine evidence convergence, historical outcomes, live testing and self-detected errors without allowing history to override current evidence.
preferred_strategy.reason: This strategy currently provides the best balance between evidence quality, opportunity discovery, adaptation and self-correction.

weaknesses.description: Evidence supporting decisions is not sufficiently stable.

correction_options.name: Increase acceptance evidence
correction_options.change: Increase the importance of explicit acceptance criteria and verifiable completion conditions.
correction_options.benefit: Improve distinction between declared work and executable checkable work.
correction_options.risk: Some genuine requests may not contain formal acceptance criteria.

correction_options.name: Strengthen completion exclusion
correction_options.change: Maintain strong exclusion of completed work while separating payment language from verified settlement.
correction_options.benefit: Reduce pursuit of work that is already finished.
correction_options.risk: Completion language can occasionally refer to partial or unrelated work.

correction_options.name: Strengthen evidence convergence
correction_options.change: Increase the importance of converging work-request signals before high-confidence action.
correction_options.benefit: Reduce false positives created by isolated request-like language.
correction_options.risk: Could reduce sensitivity to unusual genuine opportunities.

correction_options.name: Protect atypical opportunities
correction_options.change: Keep unusual opportunity patterns as separate candidates instead of discarding them automatically.
correction_options.benefit: Reduce over-pruning and preserve potentially genuine non-standard work.

correction_options.name: Constrain historical adaptation
correction_options.change: Historical learning remains a modifier only and never overrides current primary evidence.
correction_options.benefit: Prevent past outcomes from distorting current opportunity evaluation.
correction_options.risk: Historical learning will influence decisions more slowly.

selected_correction.name: Increase acceptance evidence
selected_correction.change: Increase the importance of explicit acceptance criteria and verifiable completion conditions.
selected_correction.benefit: Improve distinction between declared work and executable checkable work.
selected_correction.risk: Some genuine requests may not contain formal acceptance criteria.

principles: Historical learning is a modifier, not truth.
A single observation cannot justify permanent rule deployment.
Atypical opportunities must not be erased by over-pruning.
Payment language is not proof of settlement.
Every correction must be measurable and reversible.

next_stage.purpose: Validate the selected correction against fresh evidence before any rule deployment.
